t: From Monolith to Plugins: An AI-Assisted Architectural Refactor
s: This article details the refactoring of Pipulate's monolithic MCP tools file into a modular plugin system, driven by the need to improve AI coding assistant effectiveness and manage code complexity while retaining developer control and understanding.
sub: Refactoring MCP tools from monolith to plugins
AI coding assistant limitations with large files
Balancing developer workflow vs. modular best practices
Pipulate's architecture and AI agent interaction
